title: Laboratory 07 · Azure delivery controls and identity
topics: D2.7 live deployment, follow-up and cleanup
duration: 45–60 minutes offline; live timing depends on instructor readiness
description: Follow five existing steps: construct GitHub Actions and map identity offline; merge the authorized PR; write the note and inspect Azure; make one tag update and confirm no-change; obtain separate full-cleanup authorization. No earlier lab or Azure account is needed offline. Only the exact owner-ready private copy can deploy; public templates and unapproved copies remain disabled. AgentAlvine observes, never authorizes Azure.
completion: The educational observer found successful named plan, automatic exact-plan apply, fresh no-change and separately authorized cleanup jobs at the applicable revisions. It does not independently verify Azure configuration or resource absence, and progress is not Azure authorization. The preparation note alone cannot complete live steps; a baseline run is not proof of a later capstone revision. Return here after Lab 8 for newly reviewed capstone deployment, follow-up and dedicated owner-authorized cleanup in the same single-writer repository. Every laboratory is independent; the catalogue order is a learning recommendation, not a requirement to create or finish another repository.
